verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents several official MCP servers. A hosted search MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT search and retrieve site content. An admin MCP server gives agents write access to edit pages, update settings and open PRs. A Mintlify Index MCP server provides read-only access, and MCP is listed as a platform feature on the pricing page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully; setup and auth details are not shown in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT to your hosted search MCP server so they can search and retrieve content from your site.
Give AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor write access to your Mintlify content and dashboard so they can edit pages, update settings, and open PRs.
The Mintlify Index MCP server gives AI tools read-only access to technical documentation and web context.
